column2: gas in the tubes: the cards fill every tube with the shared woodwind exhaled-breath pack breath-woodwind-exhaled-coltman1966-nederveen1969 (27 C, 101325 Pa, saturated, 4.5 percent dry CO2 and 16.5 percent dry O2; Coltman, J. Acoust. Soc. Am. 40(1), 1966, p. 101; Nederveen, Acoustical Aspects of Woodwind Instruments, 1969, sec. 12 p. 28; Fletcher and Rossing, The Physics of Musical Instruments, sec. 8.1 p. 191), because the cards model a played zampona. The pack is the generic woodwind breath state (the top of its own 2.5 to 4.5 percent CO2 breath-cycle bracket), not a measurement of a played pan pipe, and it is applied here to stopped pipes blown across their open top. The nearest measured bore is a played flute, which is also blown across its mouth hole: Coltman, Physics Today 21(11), 1968, p. 27, found about 2.5 percent CO2 and 25.8 to 26.5 C in a 21 C room, which an ideal-gas sum (SunnySnow, Agent Mail 9244) puts about 5.7 cents above this pack's state. No bore temperature or composition measured in a played pan pipe is in the library, and the closed half of a stopped pipe may stay nearer room temperature than a flute's open bore. The renderer's breath gas has a sound speed of 345.36 m/s against 343.2 m/s for the dry 20 C air the tube lengths were derived at, so every tube sounds 10.9 to 11.0 cents higher than with dry air (measured on D3, G3, D4, G4 and B4 with one binary; three jet seeds on G4 and B4 agree to 0.01 Hz)

the blowing pressure reaches the voice as a staircase at the cards' control rate, 1000 Hz: fs-scenario samples the gesture once per control tick and the voice holds that value until the next. A 50 ms onset ramp arrives as 50 steps, the first jumping from 0 to 1/50 of the target pressure, and the 10.5 ms release as about 10, the last dropping to 0. A finer rate is refused (MagentaBadger, Agent Mail 8043: 2000 and 4000 Hz on recorder a1 and whistle D5, 48000 Hz on recorder f1 and a1, whistle D5 and G5 and flute G4): a smooth ramp passes through pressures of a fraction of a Pa, where the jet is slower than its convection history allows, and the voice refuses rather than run outside its domain. A real breath passes those pressures in a few milliseconds; below some speed there is a slow viscous flow and no convected jet. The cards stay at 1000 Hz until the jet has a stated state below its lowest valid speed
column5: onset and release claims: speaking time, the attack transient and any line at 1 kHz; no finer rate renders, so the staircase's own effect on the attack cannot be A/B tested
column6: a jet with a stated state below its lowest valid speed (no jet below a stated threshold speed, or a convection history sized for the slowest jet the gesture reaches); then the cards move to a fine control rate with their controls budget raised
